missing_or_unproven_inputs.rule: Must be historically fixed and demonstrably published before each EIA release. Bloomberg is the source-faithful expectation route for Chiou-Wei/Linn/Zhu and the underlying Bloomberg survey family is also used by Gay/Simkins/Turac; Gu/Kurov/Stan state their study uses Genesis plus Bloomberg. Platts is a separately labeled independent analyst-survey route and Estimize a distinct forecaster-population comparator. Actual storage change, later analyst histories, or fitted expectations are not substitutes.

Capacity availability must be distinct from utilization/feedgas and from global LNG prices. Terminal-pipeline mapping, scheduled-quantity semantics, posting timestamps, historical depth and cross-terminal coverage must be audited before promotion.

EIA WTI spot and fixed-rank futures histories provide deep public candidates. Match the exact oil benchmark and timing semantics used by the selected literature specification before execution.

Use the authors' RepOD replication package for exact first-pass reproduction. A later independent reconstruction may use official ICE TTF plus ENTSOG/GIE controls, but ICE historical market-data entitlement must be verified.

Exact weather-provider identity and source-study variable timing must be verified before feasibility; the 2024+ issued-forecast archive is not a valid substitute for this reproduction.
